title: Spicy Mexican Quesadillas
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional quesadillas, filled with melted cheese, chiles, and a hint of tangy flavors.

ingredients.name: Diced Chiles (such as Anaheim or Poblano)

instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
2. In a bowl, mix together the cheese blend and diced chiles.
3. Add the chopped cilantro to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
4. Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
5. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
7. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
8. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
9. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with tangy salsa.
